pages.intro: The head sets damage and the on-hit trick.

pages.title: Effects
pages.text: $(l)Bleed$(): 3s of bleeding. $(l)Piercing$(): extra damage against armour. $(l)Puller$(): drags the target toward you. $(l)Resonance$(): a delayed follow-up hit. $(l)Distance$(): more damage the further it flew. $(l)Grappling$(): yanks you to where it lands. $(l)Rope$(): lets a climbable line down from a ceiling. $(l)Potion Payload$(): dip it to carry any potion. $(l)Singularity$(): creative only.
